fields.climate: temperate; two rainy seasons (February to April, November to January); mild in mountains with frost and snow possible
fields.terrain: mostly grassy uplands and hills; relief is mountainous with altitude declining from west to east
fields.hazards: periodic droughts; the volcanic Virunga Mountains are in the northwest along the border with Democratic Republic of the Congo…
fields.resources: gold, cassiterite (tin ore), wolframite (tungsten ore), methane, hydropower, arable land
fields.farm: bananas, cassava, sweet potatoes, plantains, potatoes, maize, beans, pumpkins/squash, taro, sorghum
fields.exports: gold, rare earth ores, coffee, tea, tin ores
fields.industries: cement, agricultural products, small-scale beverages, soap, furniture, shoes, plastic goods, textiles, cigarettes
fields.languages: Kinyarwanda (official, universal Bantu vernacular) 93.2%, French (official) <0.1%, English (official) <0.1%, Swahili/Kiswahili (official, used in commercial centers) <0.1%, more than one language…
fields.religions: Catholic 39.9%, Pentecostal 21.3%, Protestant 14.6%, Adventist 12.2%, other Christians 4.2%, no religion 3.0%, Muslim 2.0%, other religions 2.0%; less than 1%: Jehovah Witness, not specified, Animist
fields.legal: mixed system of civil law, based on German and Belgian models, and customary law; Supreme Court reviews legislative acts
fields.military: typically 18-30 years of age for men and women for voluntary military service (including officer candidates and those with university degrees and specialized qualifications)…
